## Fork notice

The canonical project documentation for this repository now lives in the root [`README.md`](../README.md).

This repository is an Emmolab-maintained fork of the original upstream Web-Check project, focused on:

- whitelabel branding
- bundled Cyberbro threat-intel cards
- Docker / GHCR deployment
- a smaller automation surface for the workflows we actually use

For setup, deployment, and fork-specific notes, see [`../README.md`](../README.md).
